snippet.title: ShareThyme baking competition with former GBBO contestants Val and Selasi
snippet.description:
To celebrate ShareThyme’s new ambassadors, two lucky winners were given the chance to experience a personal baking masterclass with the one and only, Val and Selasi - former GBBO contestants.

Being known for their legendary cross-generational friendship and a shining example of the ShareThyme mission, Val and Selasi have teamed up in the ultimate Bakewell Tart competition to pass on their tips, tricks and secrets. Watch how they connected through baking. 

Fancy a slice of ShareThyme? Get involved now: sharethyme.co.uk/getinvolved

snippet.title: ShareThyme - an innovative new platform build in 8 days (clip 4 of 4)
snippet.description:
Watch the full video here:http://bit.ly/2lfy3J4

ShareThyme is our very first internally built social impact project. It’s a brand new platform that helps connect adults aged 65+ who love to cook with younger people keen to learn new recipes. 

It took us just 8 days to build ShareThyme, by bringing together a fully cross-functional Badger team and our Product Strategy process. The project’s success shows how an innovative platform can be built at speed and scale, without risk.

Want to get involved? Become part of the ShareThyme community now at sharethyme.co.uk

Watch the full video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i_u3XzapcLM&feature=youtu.be

ShareThyme is our very first internally built social impact project. It’s a brand new platform that helps connect adults aged 65+ who love to cook with younger people keen to learn new recipes. 

It took us just 8 days to build ShareThyme, by bringing together a fully cross-functional Badger team and our Product Strategy process. The project’s success shows how an innovative platform can be built at speed and scale, without risk.

Want to get involved? Become part of the ShareThyme community now at sharethyme.co.uk 

Or, get a flavour of how we built the platform on red-badger.com We're thrilled to reveal our very first internally built social impact project. It’s a brand new platform called ShareThyme which helps connect adults aged 65+ who love to cook with younger people keen to learn new recipes. 

It took us just 8 days to build ShareThyme, by bringing together a fully cross-functional Badger team and our Product Strategy process. The project’s success shows how an innovative platform can be built at speed and scale, without risk.

It’s still early days and we’re experimenting with the concept to learn from our MVP (minimum viable product) through testing with users. We’re delighted to have developed this platform in such a short amount of time.

Want to get involved? Become part of the ShareThyme community now at sharethyme.com or get a flavour of how we built the platform on red-badger.com
